description: Source code implementing the Android NNAPI backend for PyTorch JIT, including class NnapiBackend with methods for compilation and execution, and internal initialization logic.

classes.name: NnapiBackend
classes.description: Implements the Android NNAPI backend delegate for PyTorch JIT, providing methods for checking availability, compiling models, and executing them with memory format adjustments.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Returns true indicating the backend is available.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Wraps the processed input into a dictionary with key 'forward' and returns it as a generic dict.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs execution of the compiled model with input tensors, handling memory format adjustments and output reformatting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the NNAPI compilation object and shape compute module based on serialized model and inputs.
